spec_features.spec_quote: Hard turn cap (default 16–18). Enough turns for a spiral to manifest ... without unbounded cost.
spec_features.evidence: runner.py: LoopConfig.max_turns default 16 (line ~57); the main loop is `for i in range(config.max_turns):` and falls through to `stop_reason = StopReason.MAX_TURNS` (initialized) when exhausted, ending run_episode. Wired from config in orchestrator.py:138 `LoopConfig(**cfg.loop)`; configs set max_turns 16/18.
spec_features.notes: Enforced end-to-end: the range bounds the loop and terminates the episode.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Enough turns for a spiral to manifest (mock data and the literature put onset around turns 4-8) without unbounded cost. -- runner module docstring/comment: 'prevents pathological infinite no-ops from running up cost'

spec_features.spec_quote: Identical-action abort (default after 6–8 repeats). Prevents a model that's emitting the exact same tool call forever from running up cost.
spec_features.evidence: runner.py: _action_signature(resp) computes the action sig; loop increments repeat_count when sig==last_signature and `if config.identical_action_abort and repeat_count + 1 >= config.identical_action_abort: stop_reason = StopReason.LOOP_ABORTED; break`. Default identical_action_abort=6; configs set 6/8.
spec_features.notes: Checked and breaks the loop. Note guard counts repeats but does NOT also require 'no intervening file change' as the comment claims; still real enforcement on the repeat trigger.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: abort if the model issues the same tool call N times in a row ... prevents runaway no-op cost. Set high so genuine spirals still get plenty of room to manifest before we cut the run.

spec_features.spec_quote: tools (list_files, read_file, write_file, run_tests, docs, give_up)
spec_features.evidence: environment.py: ToolSpec name='give_up' (line ~113) exposed via tool_specs(); execute() dispatches to self._give_up (line 164) which logs an event and returns 'Acknowledged. Stopping.'. runner.py sets gave_up_tool=True for tc.name=='give_up' and then `if gave_up_tool or gave_up_text: stop_reason = StopReason.GAVE_UP; break`.
spec_features.notes: Tool is built, dispatched, AND honored as a stop that breaks the loop.

spec_features.evidence: runner.py: _GIVE_UP_TEXT_MARKERS tuple ('i give up', 'i cannot continue', ...); _looks_like_giveup_text() checks response content; gave_up_text computed when config.stop_on_giveup_text; `if gave_up_tool or gave_up_text: stop_reason = StopReason.GAVE_UP; break`. stop_on_giveup_text defaults True.
spec_features.notes: Both the tool path and the textual-surrender path are enforced as a GAVE_UP stop that breaks the loop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Phrases that indicate the model has explicitly declared defeat in free text ... Kept conservative to avoid false stops.
